name: DeDanix Quote Builder for WooCommerce
author: dedanix

sections.description:
DeDanix Quote Builder for WooCommerce helps stores collect professional quote
requests, generate basic PDF quotations and let customers review their quote
history from My Account.

It is built for WooCommerce shops that need a request-a-quote workflow before
checkout: B2B stores, wholesale catalogs, custom pricing products, made-to-order
items, service packages and products where the final decision needs a quotation
document before purchase.

Instead of replacing WooCommerce, the plugin keeps the quote request process
close to your existing products, variations, taxes, customers and admin tools.
Customers can search products, build a request, submit it, and later download
their issued PDF quote from their account.

Free includes:

  • Unlimited WooCommerce quote requests.
  • Frontend quote builder with product and variation search.
  • Quantity selection and live tax-aware totals.
  • Quote requests from the visual builder or WooCommerce cart.
  • Admin quote creation, editing, search and status management.
  • Basic PDF quote documents with preserved issued revisions.
  • Integrity checks for generated quote documents.
  • Customer My Quotes area with status, totals and PDF downloads.
  • Responsive Elementor widget with layout, typography and color controls.
  • Shortcode support with [dedanix_quote_builder].
  • WordPress privacy exporter and eraser integration.
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.

For stores that later need a more complete sales workflow, the optional
DeDanix Quote Builder Pro add-on can extend the same quote data with email
notifications, shipping estimates, customer acceptance/rejection, WooCommerce
order conversion, discounts, expiration workflows and advanced PDF branding.
The Free edition does not expire and quotation volume is not limited.

The optional PDF credit is disabled by default. Merchants may explicitly enable
a “Generated with DeDanix Quote Builder” link in PDF settings.

Learn more at https://dedanix.com/quote-builder/

Privacy

The plugin stores quotation contact information, requested products, prices,
taxes, notes, statuses and generated documents. It integrates with WordPress
personal data export and erasure tools. Erasure anonymizes personal identity
while preserving non-personal commercial history where appropriate.

The plugin does not contact DeDanix or any external tracking service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin folder or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  3. Activate DeDanix Quote Builder for WooCommerce.
  4. Open DeDanix Quotes > Settings and configure company and builder details.
  5. Add the DeDanix Quote Builder widget in Elementor, or use the automatically
    created builder page.
sections.faq:
Is the Free edition limited by a monthly quota?

No. Quote requests and issued basic PDF quotations are unlimited in the Free
edition.

Does it work without Elementor?

Yes. The Builder is also available through the generated page and the
[dedanix_quote_builder] shortcode. Elementor adds a visual editing experience.

Can customers download quote PDFs?

Yes. Administrators can issue basic PDF quote documents, and customers can
download available PDFs from the My Quotes area in their WooCommerce account.

Is this a WooCommerce request-a-quote plugin?

Yes. It adds a quote builder and quote request workflow to WooCommerce while
keeping your product catalog, variations, taxes and customer account area in
place.

Is it useful for B2B or wholesale stores?

Yes. The Free edition is useful when customers need to request a price quote,
custom pricing review or PDF quotation before a final order is placed.

Does Free send quotation emails?

No. Customer and administrator email notifications are provided by the
separate Pro add-on. Customers can still access linked quotations in My Account.

Does Free calculate shipping?

No. Automatic and manual quotation shipping estimates belong to the separate
Pro add-on. WooCommerce can still calculate shipping later during checkout.

Are previously generated quotations preserved?

Yes. Quotes, immutable revisions and documents remain stored unless the
merchant explicitly enables permanent deletion on uninstall.

Is the DeDanix PDF credit mandatory?

No. It is optional, disabled by default and never required for operation.
sections.changelog:
2.0.3

  • Fixed frontend quote builder initialization on block themes and cached pages.
  • Improved product search reliability on fresh WooCommerce stores.

2.0.1

  • Fixed WordPress.org review findings for text-domain consistency.
  • Replaced short internal public prefixes with plugin-specific identifiers.
  • Added a safe migration path for existing quote tables using the previous
    table prefix.

2.0.0

  • Introduced the unlimited WordPress.org Free edition.
  • Preserved the complete responsive Elementor Quote Builder experience.
  • Removed trial quotas and locked feature screens.
  • Moved email, shipping, customer decisions, order conversion and expiration
    workflows to the separate Pro architecture.
  • Added an optional, opt-in DeDanix credit to basic PDFs.
  • Preserved historical 1.9.x quote, shipping, decision and order data as
    read-only records.
